title: SIMD F_5 plus F_7 kernels in gf2-kernels-simd
description:
Instantiate the generic `BatchedBipedalLike` framework (T16) for F_5 and F_7 in `gf2-kernels-simd`, with proptest cross-checks against the scalar packed types.

## Background

Once T16 (the generic framework) and T17/T19 (per-prime packed types and op formulas) are in place, the SIMD kernels are a small wiring task: define `BipedalLikeConfig` impls for F_5 and F_7, instantiate `BatchedBipedalLike` for each, expose lane-batch primitives that `gf2-algebra` dispatches to.

Same `unsafe` and asm-artefact rules as T12.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-kernels-simd::bipedal::packed5` and `gf2-kernels-simd::bipedal::packed7` modules exist ~~with `BipedalLikeConfig` impls and AVX2 instantiations~~ **with AVX2-backed runtime-detection bundles + scalar fallbacks** (see Amendment 2026-05-14).
- [ ] [hard] Lane-batch `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` proptest-match scalar `Packed5`/`Packed7` ops on 1000 random inputs each.
- [ ] [hard] Runtime AVX2 detection wires through; scalar fallback when absent.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-kernels-simd --release --profile ci` passes.
- [ ] [hard] `asm-artefact-present` gate passes for both kernels.
- [ ] [aspirational] AVX-512 paths exist for both primes, gated behind `cfg(target_feature = "avx512f")`. **Deferred — not implemented in this issue (see Amendment 2026-05-14).**

## Amendment 2026-05-14 (user-approved — drop BipedalLikeConfig requirement for F_5/F_7)

The original criterion 1 required `BipedalLikeConfig` impls for both F_5 and F_7. The post-R1 / post-R2 encoding decisions made this infeasible:

- **F_5 (R1 Candidate D)** uses a 3-plane bit-sliced encoding `(b0, b1, b2)` per operand. The `BipedalLikeConfig` trait's `MagLane` / `SgnLane` associated types impose a 2-plane `(mag, sgn)` shape per operand, which cannot losslessly represent F_5 value 4 (which requires `b2 = 1`). A `Config5: BipedalLikeConfig` impl that zeroes `b2` silently corrupts results for any input containing value 4 — a correctness violation.
- **F_7 (R2 Candidate A)** uses a 3-bit-per-lane LUT encoding (`ADD7_LUT`, `SUB7_LUT`, `MUL7_LUT`), which fits in 1 plane per operand. A `Config7: BipedalLikeConfig` impl that ignores the `sgn` plane is technically faithful but dead code, since the production F_7 path already uses dedicated single-plane LUT batch entry points.

**Resolution:** F_5 and F_7 ship via dedicated AVX2 batch entry points (`run_add5_batch`, `run_sub5_batch`, `run_mul5_batch`, `run_neg5_batch` in `x86/bipedal_avx2_packed5.rs`; same family for F_7 in `x86/bipedal_avx2_packed7.rs`) plus runtime-detection bundles (`F5AvxFns`, `F7AvxFns`) and scalar fallbacks. The `BipedalLikeConfig` framework integration is dropped — it cannot honestly support the post-R1 / post-R2 encodings without an architectural extension (3-plane `BipedalLikeConfig` variant), which is out of scope for this issue.

The criterion text above is amended to read "AVX2-backed runtime-detection bundles + scalar fallbacks" instead of "BipedalLikeConfig impls and AVX2 instantiations". All other criteria (proptest cross-checks, runtime detection, `cargo nextest`, `asm-artefact-present`) are unchanged.

The aspirational AVX-512 criterion is recorded as deferred (no implementation in this issue). A future SIMD-platform-expansion issue (`f8d230ef` and siblings in epic `7f809931`) is the natural home for AVX-512 F_5/F_7 work.

Approved by user 2026-05-14 (epic ae82bd73 session 8, AskUserQuestion option A: "Amend criterion: drop BipedalLikeConfig requirement for F_5/F_7").
